To play a Standard entry you need to select 7 numbers (between 1 and 47) in each game panel.

Winning combinations There are 7 Oz Lotto prize divisions. The winning combinations and odds of winning each Oz Lotto prize division (based on 1 standard game) are shown below. wiing combinations above.

7 winning numbers Odds of winning (based on 1 standard game) are 62,891,499:1
6 winning numbers + 1 supplementary Odds of winning (based on 1 standard game) are 2,994,834:1
6 winning numbers Odds of winning (based on 1 standard game) are 242,825:1
5 winning numbers + 1 supplementary Odds of winning (based on 1 standard game) are 26,271:1
5 winning numbers Odds of winning (based on 1 standard game) are 4,497:1
4 winning numbers Odds of winning (based on 1 standard game) are 182:1
3 winning numbers + 1 supplementary Odds of winning (based on 1 standard game) are 71:1

A System entry gives you the option to play more than the standard 7 numbers in an Oz Lotto game. You can choose from 8 to 20 numbers giving you more chances to win.
